Without an anchor the reparandum would not be linked to anything (R5). `quantity.n.01` is a noun referent, so I added an `entity.n.01` anchor right before `CORRECTION`.

   - `year.n.01 Quantity -3` reaches the anchor at 2.

   - `more.r.01 Theme -7` reaches Sam at 0, `Value -2` reaches year at 5, and `Co-Theme +1` reaches Tom at 8.
